script_run.description: Firmware requesting script to start or resume execution. Sent when conditions are safe to continue (e.g., after clearing a light curtain or pressing cycle start button).

script_hold.description: Firmware requesting script to pause execution. Sent when a safety condition is triggered (e.g., light curtain, door open, emergency stop) or operator requests pause.

params.description: Human-readable reason for the hold (e.g., 'Light curtain zone 1 triggered', 'Door opened')

script_reset.description: Firmware requesting script to abort and reset to beginning. Sent on critical errors or when operator presses reset button.

params.description: Human-readable reason for the reset (e.g., 'Emergency stop pressed', 'Critical fault detected')
